Escape the busy streets of Prague for a day and discover one of the most beautiful corners of Czechia. This guided day trip takes you north to Bohemian Switzerland National Park, a landscape of towering sandstone formations, deep gorges and quiet forests close to the German border.

The walking is flat and gentle, covering around 5 km in total. Bring sun protection, a hat and comfortable closed shoes. Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed, but the guide will make the most of every opportunity the day brings.

You will visit the Museo Gauchesco Ricardo Güiraldes, watch silversmiths and leatherworkers at their craft, and settle into your hotel for the evening with time to stroll the riverside.

Guests who wish to can take a gentle guided ride across the open grassland. Back in town, your guide will suggest a local restaurant for dinner.
